shadowSentences: I love reading books every night.
My favorite hobby is painting landscapes.
Traveling brings me joy and new experiences.
I enjoy cooking different types of cuisine.
Running in the park helps me relax and think.
Learning new languages opens up many opportunities.
Volunteering at the shelter is very rewarding for me.
Spending time with family strengthens our bonds.
Exploring local markets introduces me to unique cultures.
Practicing mindfulness daily enhances my overall well-being.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel experiences.
questions: Q1: Can you share a memorable trip you have taken?
Q2: What challenges did you face while traveling?
Q3: What do you think is the most important aspect of traveling?
Q4: What advice would you give someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about healthy eating habits.
questions: Q1: What is your favorite healthy meal to prepare?
Q2: What do you find difficult about maintaining a healthy diet?
Q3: How do you think healthy eating impacts your daily life?
Q4: What tips would you suggest for someone trying to eat healthier?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about effective study methods.
questions: Q1: What study techniques have worked best for you?
Q2: Have you ever struggled with a particular subject? How did you cope?
Q3: In your opinion, what is the key to effective studying?
Q4: What advice would you give to students for improving their study habits?
